Buses involved are IEEE bus ids 1 through 14 from the bus name column. Bus 1 is the slack bus with fixed 1.06 p.u. and 0 degrees. PV generator buses are 2, 3, 6, and 8 with specified voltage magnitudes. PQ load buses are 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, and 14, while buses 2, 3, and 6 also have local load and generation.

Branches involved are 15 lines with line_id equal to the net.line row index 0 through 14, and 5 transformers with line_id equal to 100000 plus the net.trafo row index, so 100000 through 100004. Line flow requested is the active power at the from side or hv side / first listed side of each branch.

Quantities requested are bus voltage magnitude in per unit and angle in degrees, branch sending-end active power in MW, branch loading in percent, and system totals in MW. Since branch thermal ratings are undefined, loading_percent is reported as 0 for every branch.

Relative to the standard IEEE 14-bus case, the given loads and scheduled generation are already the case definition on 100 MVA base. The AC power flow must satisfy active power balance so total generation equals total load plus total losses. Reactive balance is handled internally by generator and slack reactive outputs, but only MW totals are requested in the final schema.
